name: Frog Grog
description: Once honest grog. Now green-gold and faintly fizzing, with notes of onion, garlic, questionable eel and poor judgment. Restores 30 HP and dulls the fumes for a while. Side effects vary.

table.text: <o>WARMED UP!</> It burns all the way down. Mostly in a good way.
<g>STENCH RESISTANCE.</> Nothing will ever smell worse than that.
<y>*BUUURP*</> A small yellow cloud escapes. Everyone steps back.
DIZZY. The deck is doing a little dance. The deck denies it.
